question: can a rank-22 scheme share 21 terms with an EXHAUSTIVELY enumerated split-refined anchor, i.e. can 21 of an anchor's 23+m terms absorb the dropped deficit in a single rank-1 tensor?
whyNew: R76's driver picks anchors with stride 1 + (a % 7) * (m + 2), so its layer cap of 2400/1200/400 selects only SEVEN strides and produced 7 anchors per base out of the 38/59/55 available slots (m=1) and 7 out of 703/1711/1485 (m=2). Raising that cap re-enumerates the same seven. This round enumerates the space directly.

instrument.crossCheck: unfoldingRankAtMostOne, an independent Segre-identity formulation, run on every survivor and on a 1-in-512 sample of refuted rows (50035 rows); a disagreement is counted as undecided, never as a verdict
instrument.budget: none inside the test; only anchor enumeration is time-boxed and its unscreened part is reported as UNSCREENED
instrument.field: integer arithmetic, so a refutation holds over Q, Z and every F_p alike; it says nothing about R <= 22 in general

relation: at R = 23 + m terms, dropping k = m + 2 leaves 21 kept and needs j = 22 - 21 = 1 extra term

controls.name: anchor-exactness
controls.detail: verify() on 16 split anchors across m=1,2,3: all exact at rank 23+m, 0 bad, 11 refused as degenerate splits (not applicable, not bad)

controls.name: positive-control-rank1
controls.detail: 40 planted rank-1 tensors accepted by both oracles: 40 ok, 0 rejected

controls.name: factorisation-roundtrip
controls.detail: integral gcd factorisation reproduced 17/40 planted rank-1 tensors. NON-GATING: this bounds the candidate-CONSTRUCTION path, not the screen. A failure here can only LOSE candidates — buildCandidate returns the survivor with a note and no scheme, never a refutation and never a witness — so it cannot hide a rank-22 scheme, it can only under-report one. KNOWN BUG, not yet fixed: factorRank1 derives u[a] = D[a][b0][c0]/M(b0,c0) = u[a]/u[a0], which is not integral when u[a0] does not divide u[a] (planted factors draw from {-3..3}). The fix is the primitive a-column, u[a] = D[a][b0][c0]/gcd_a D[.][b0][c0], with the leftover scalar gcd_a reabsorbed into v or w

controls.name: negative-control-rank2
controls.detail: 40 planted rank-2 (sum of two rank-1) tensors rejected by both oracles: 40/40
